newsitem.title: USA: Forest Laboratories sees loss for 2 qtrs.
newsitem.headline: Forest Laboratories sees loss for 2 qtrs.

text.p: Forest Laboratories Inc said it sees operating losses for the next two quarters and for all of fiscal 1997, while sales will be reduced over the remaining two quarters of the fiscal year ending March 31, 1997, and possibly the first quarter of fiscal 1998.

The pharmaceutical manufacturer and marketer said that the losses will result from eliminating trade incentives for all of its branded products in order to reduce high trade inventory levels, principally of Aerobi, an inhaled steroid product used in treating asthma.

The company said it had previously planned to reduce the trade inventory gradually, but after Aerobid's growth declined it decided to substantially reduce the high inventory levels that limit current sales.

"Looking forward, we expect revenues and earnings for the last three quarters of fiscal 1998 to fall within the range of analysts' current expectations," Forest Labs president Howard Solomon said in a statement.
Forest Labs shares were indicated to open at 30-34, sharply down from Tuesday's 38-3/4 close. Morgan Stanley downgraded the stock to neutral from outperform.
